column1: # Alternative H5 clock rates for a run whose tips are ALL H5N1, passed with
# --auspiceClockRates. The shipped RESOURCES/auspice_clock_rates.tsv uses the h5nx values
# instead, because an H5 tree normally pools H5N1 with H5N2/H5N3/H5N4.
# Same caveats as the shipped table: keyed by subtype, not by clade, and fitted for 2-year
# build windows. PhyloAuspice derives the std-dev as rate / 5, not nextstrain's fixed 0.00211.
# Columns (tab-separated): subtype, segment, rate, generic (yes/no), source.
